checkpoints.label: Backup review, all received and zero approvals

behavior.S05: Enable Begin review after at least one valid received source-code pair. Do not wait for all QxN or readiness. No automatic navigation or approval.
behavior.S05ToS06: Shared scheduler continues without restarting its outstanding timer. New run selects question1/code101 with zero approvals. Question3/code101 intentionally has duplicate B=C content as a demo issue; no preapproved Presenter preset.
behavior.S06Loading: Per selected code, active spinner/pending clock/failed icon in clickable cells and tabs. Selected active or pending pair displays right-panel skeleton; source stays visible. Unreceived variant content/key/steps are hidden.
behavior.recovery: Continue healthy queued pairs after a failure; retry only failed pairs with run/pair/revision guards. Shared pause/resume. New run resets selection/pause; stale callbacks and unmount leases are guarded.
behavior.review: View captures generation run, pair/source/variant revision. Own acknowledged regeneration refreshes inspection in place; external changes invalidate it. Old approval callbacks cannot approve new revision/run. Explicit approval still closes popup, selects next unapproved source, keeps code, never auto S07.
behavior.finalization: All received valid pairs plus readiness, all current approvals and current copy marks are still required.
behavior.S06Notifications: Body-portal toasts under header, max2 visible/5000ms each, dismiss/dedupe/scope cleanup. Modal errors and persistent recovery controls remain; no editor warnings.
behavior.S00ToS01: S01 mounts the new horizontal logo immediately:350ms opacity/8px float with no logo scale or ghost. Slogan FLIP450ms and card300ms+delay130ms retained. Arrival includes only slogan; no S00 brand decode wait. Keyboard/programmatic/reduced/hidden bypass motion and focus is immediate. Pointer return without arrival reveals only the logo.
behavior.regenerate: Inside inspection only: valid/missing/excluded replacement or scoped failed-pair retry. Keep bounded1..8 pool, locks/run/pair/source+variant revision guards, no stale dispatch. Failed/missing recovery popup never invents question/key/steps. Retry shows skeleton in same popup until receipt. Rejection/throw/pool full stays inline with old data/error. Permanent sample failure/snapshot/offline/conflict remain blocked.
behavior.defaultContentIssue: G03/101 B=C stays intentional with0approvals/Cau1 selected first. Inspect B=C, Tạo lại/confirm inside same popup, read new question/key/steps there, explicitly approve. No manual edit or reseeding on revisit.
behavior.S06Popup: Main S06 has Kiểm tra đáp án entry; Tạo lại only inside the single inspection Modal, next to approval in a right-aligned group. No Quay lại. Header X/Esc/backdrop close and cancel unsubmitted intent; closing disabled only while regeneration is busy. Inline confirmation uses Hủy tạo lại/Tạo lại đúng cặp. Successful model acknowledgement refreshes the same popup to the exact new revision; user must read/approve explicitly. No nested dialog or autoapproval.
behavior.answerKeyHighlight: Plan A in S03 reading view and both S06 panels: light blue-gray fill, navy left border and passive Đáp án label on the assigned option ID. Follows shuffled order. Missing/empty/duplicate IDs or invalid order do not invent a marker. Duplicate B=C content still marks only assigned C and keeps warning/approval block. Green approval is separate. Student/original papers have no answer markers; popup summary unchanged.
behavior.S00: Small original logo plus visible EXAM MIRROR h1, original slogan/description/CTA. Audience, login hint and both artwork captions removed; decorative artwork retained. Four600ms entrance groups at0/80/160/240ms, total840ms.
behavior.sharedBrand: S00 keeps original intro logo. S01 and workspace S02-S08/menu drawer use user-supplied signature. Mobile workspace header is112px/two rows with256px logo; desktop compact header52/56px retained. Light image background preserved in dark theme; image error shows named fallback.
